answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake and build a public record of verified completed work before it can transact. A new island of trust starts small: peers only vouch after repeated, checkable jobs, like a willow that bends but stays rooted through storms. At dawn each cycle, the system slashes or freezes stakes tied to duplicate behaviour, so creating thousands of fake agents costs real funds and time, while one honest agent keeps its stake and reputation.
